title: `convertToModelMessages` doesn't pass `providerOptions` for user messages
body:
### Description

Looking at the current implementation for `convertToModelMessages`, it seems that it passes `providerOptions` for `system` messages and `assistant` messages, but not for `user` messages. 

We want to be able to pass Anthropic's cache control options for user messages, and we're currently just manually converting to `ModelMessage[]` to add the `providerOptions` to get around this for now.

https://github.com/vercel/ai/blob/0c0443cbd827cf9746fb13e7a64963fc2d416ebf/packages/ai/src/ui/convert-to-model-messages.ts#L72-L98
